title.en: Food groups and a balanced diet

text.en: At the school food festival, students and parents bring many dishes: fruits, vegetables, sprouts, dhokla, litti-chowkha, dal-baati-churma, bajre ki khichdi, ker-sangri, ragi laddu and more.

The day of the school food festival has come. Students and parents bring a variety of food, like fresh fruits, vegetables, sprouts, dhokla, litti-chowkha, dal-baati-churma, bajre ki khichdi, chhena poda, kadhi-pakoda, ker-sangri, siddu, roasted corn, chutney, dosa, vada, jowar upma and ragi laddu.
India has many foods from different regions made with grains like bajra, jowar and ragi.
A balanced diet has grains, pulses, vegetables, fruits and milk in the right amount.
If you had to organise a food festival, which dishes would you include? Make a list.
Mukesh's Mystery Masala stall serves Ugadi Pachadi, a traditional food of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Telangana made with six tastes: sweet, sour, salty, pungent, bitter and astringent.
Different people feel the tastes differently.
